sourceSnapshots.title: The Bromley Local Plan
sourceSnapshots.authorityNote: Council states the Bromley Local Plan was adopted on 16 January 2019 and, with the London Plan, is used to determine planning applications.

sourceSnapshots.title: Review of the Bromley Local Plan
sourceSnapshots.authorityNote: The council's current review surface records the 2025 Direction of Travel as the second Regulation 18 consultation. The current official pages do not expose a Submission Draft Local Plan as operative development-plan policy.

sourceSnapshots.title: Direction of Travel Consultation July to September 2025
sourceSnapshots.authorityNote: Council explicitly states this document does not contain draft policies. Its stated intention to consult on a Submission Draft in Summer 2026 is a timetable statement, not evidence that such a draft has become operative.

sourceSnapshots.title: Urban Design Guide SPD
sourceSnapshots.authorityNote: The SPD guides interpretation of adopted policy; it does not create development-plan policy.

sourceSnapshots.title: Bromley Planning Validation Requirements — January 2025
sourceSnapshots.authorityNote: Current application-information guidance, not development-plan policy. Material here includes drainage evidence expectations and a current direction to use London Plan parking standards.

sourceSnapshots.title: Tree Preservation Orders (TPOs)
sourceSnapshots.authorityNote: Council directs users to its protected-trees map / enquiry route for current TPO status. DPL-RP-002's historic BB9 (1960) evidence is therefore not promoted to current site fact without a current authoritative recheck.

methodClasses.claimBoundary: Evaluates only explicit local numeric terms from admitted proposal/site facts; a numeric pass does not discharge qualitative/context duties.
Backland character, design, amenity, separation quality and context response remain planning/architectural judgement supported by evidence.
Tree, highway, flood and drainage questions require current site/specialist evidence and planning assessment; this does not replace technical design.
Planning permission, refusal, appeal and condition discharge remain external authority outcomes.
A potentially conflicting/superseded local numeric provision is not executed natively until DPL-10A conflict/temporal composition establishes the applicable relationship to later strategic policy.

obligations.title: Backland and garden-land development must avoid unacceptable character, landscape/habitat/amenity and residential-amenity harm and provide high separation/landscaping quality
requiredInputs: authoritative proposal scale / design / density / siting
evidenced local character and existing development pattern
traffic/disturbance evidence proportionate to the proposal
obligations.nonClaim: The historic larger five-house refusal demonstrates proposal-specific sensitivity; it is not a universal refusal rule for the rear-of-10 parcel.

obligations.title: Residential side-space minimum with context-sensitive higher-separation remainder
requiredInputs: minimum building-to-side-boundary distances for full building height and length
obligations.deterministicRule: for a proposal of two or more storeys, retain at least 1m to the side boundary for the full height and length of the building
obligations.judgementRemainder: Where higher standards of separation already exist, Policy 8 expects more generous side space; therefore >=1m is only the explicit numeric floor, not a complete policy pass.
obligations.nonClaim: DPL-RP-002 lacks survey/title-grade boundary geometry, so the native term cannot currently be run.

obligations.title: General high-quality design, context, amenity, inclusive access, landscape and waste-storage duties
requiredInputs: proposal architecture / layout / access / landscape evidence
adjacent scale / proportion / form / material context
daylight / sunlight / privacy / noise evidence where material
obligations.nonClaim: Urban Design Guide SPD guidance informs judgement but is not promoted into Local Plan policy.

obligations.title: Development must account for desirable existing trees on-site/adjoining, with retention/protection and suitable replanting where loss is accepted
requiredInputs: current tree survey / arboricultural impact evidence
proposal footprint / levels / access / services relative to retained trees and RPAs
obligations.nonClaim: Historic application evidence records area TPO BB9 (1960), but current 2026 TPO coverage remains unresolved until the council's current protected-tree records are checked.

obligations.title: Adopted local residential parking provisions with later London Plan composition/conflict unresolved
requiredInputs: explicit DPL-10A conflict/temporal relationship between Policy 30 numeric terms and London Plan 2021
obligations.policyFact: The adopted 2019 policy contains local residential minimum/maximum parking standards by PTAL and bedroom count.
obligations.currentGuidanceFact: Bromley's January 2025 validation requirements direct new residential car parking to London Plan Policy T6/T6.1 standards.
obligations.nonClaim: DPL-10D does not execute the 2019 local parking table as though the 2021 London Plan had not intervened; nor does validation guidance itself repeal development-plan policy.

obligations.title: Development must not significantly adversely affect road safety
requiredInputs: current access geometry / width / gradient / visibility / swept path
proposal traffic / servicing / refuse / emergency-access evidence proportionate to scale
obligations.nonClaim: The historical 3.2-3.8m private-lane description is context evidence, not current survey or highway-safety proof.

obligations.title: Flood-risk reduction and sustainable surface-water management planning duties
requiredInputs: runoff / attenuation / exceedance / maintenance evidence where due
obligations.nonClaim: The 2019 permission's drainage condition and current validation requirements prove drainage evidence is due; they do not establish an acceptable drainage solution for the current site.

excludedOrHeldSources.reason: The current official review pages at 2026-10-22 expose the 2025 Direction of Travel as the latest policy-stage consultation and do not expose a Submission Draft as operative policy. The stated Summer 2026 intention is not treated as evidence that a draft exists or carries weight.
Historic arboricultural evidence records area TPO BB9 (1960), but current council records must re-establish present coverage before DPL treats it as a current site designation.

The 2019 Local Plan contains numeric residential parking standards, but later London Plan 2021 authority and current Bromley validation guidance create a real temporal/conflict-composition question. The local table is therefore not executed natively in this packet.

proofCaseEvidence.proposal: demolition of garages and erection of one three-bedroom house to rear of 10 Highland Road
proofCaseEvidence.authorityBoundary: Proposal-specific historical external decision evidence; not a current permission assertion and not a site pass.

proofCaseEvidence.proposal: five terrace houses on larger combined rear-of-8-and-10 site
proofCaseEvidence.authorityBoundary: Different proposal and larger parcel; useful interpretation context only, not a reusable refusal rule.

composition.rule: Local and strategic obligations coexist as typed development-plan authority. No precedence is inferred from list order, locality or recency; actual conflict/supersession relations use DPL-10A planning-law semantics.
composition.guidanceRule: Adopted SPDs and validation requirements may inform evidence/judgement and application information but do not become development-plan policy.
composition.siteDesignationRule: A local target may define what a TPO/tree designation would require, but current site applicability belongs to authoritative site/designation evidence rather than being hard-coded from historical application material.

survives: typed local obligations with applicability and method class
numeric policy only where genuinely explicit and fact-supported
site-specific designation applicability separated from target semantics
proposal-specific permission/refusal evidence separated from normative policy
emerging-plan sources kept non-operative until authority changes
doesNotSurviveAsGeneric: one uniform numeric-rule portfolio across boroughs
assumption that every local numeric policy can be executed without strategic-policy conflict analysis
stillUnderdetermined: generic machine schema for borough-specific designation families beyond typed applicability/evidence refs
generic resolution of local-plan numeric policy that conflicts with later London strategic policy
whether a third materially different borough would require another method class or source-status field

nativeNow: Policy 8 explicit 1m side-space floor once exact boundary/proposal facts exist, while retaining the higher-separation judgement remainder
judgementOrExternalNow: Policy 37 general design / inclusive access / amenity
Policy 73 tree retention/protection with current arboricultural and designation evidence
Policy 30 temporal/conflict relationship to London Plan 2021
forbiddenConclusions: current TPO status inferred from historical evidence
